about: Browser runs of an Aethyr export's Unreal web build, for the engine's web harness (Engine/Platforms/Wasm/Build/Tools/web/webrun.py run --stage <WasmOut> --fixtures <this file> --fixture NAME --out <dir> [--query tier=forward|deferred]). The game prints AETHYR_ lines to the console; read them in <dir>/console.log.

aethyr-script.about: The bundle's scripted run on its own state (aethyr_script.c): the lines must equal the bundle's rules/run.expected.

aethyr-play.about: The bundle's scripted run played on screen by the game itself, 16 frames a tick: AETHYR_PLAY done, with events and things on the way.

aethyr-mine.about: Stands at the mine (stage 5) for 20 s: AETHYR_STATE lines carry frame and host milliseconds; a page shot at the end.

aethyr-keys.about: Real keys from the title: Enter starts the run, W held walks out through the scanner gate; AETHYR_STATE must reach zone 1 (the rail).

aethyr-party.about: Stands in the party (stage 8) for 15 s with the world drawing every thing: frame and host milliseconds.

aethyr-party-native.about: The same with Unreal drawing every kind from its exported model.

aethyr-gray.about: Real keys at the mine: G turns the graybox on, G again turns it off; AETHYR_STATE's gray goes 0, 1, 0, with a shot of each.

splice-play.about: Splice Bots slice 1: the bundle's scripted run played on screen by the game itself at 1440x900, 16 frames a tick, the page's own input off (the script is the input), from the title to SCENE RESTORED: AETHYR_PLAY done.

splice-keys.about: Splice Bots slice 1 with real keys at 1440x900: a click on the title, Enter (NEW RUN), Enter (USE THIS CHARACTER), W held across the solar farm, Q for the board, I and M open and shut, Esc pauses; AETHYR_STATE reaches mode 1.

splice-digger.about: Splice Bots at 1440x900: a new run from the title, then the mouse turns the view toward Digger at the solar farm; shots start and turn6..turn24 (more turn each).

splice-camera.about: Splice Bots at 1440x900, the player camera (AethyrCamera.cpp): a new run, then behind, F5 to front, F5 to first person, V back to behind; the board very fast (W and Ctrl held) behind and in first person (the sprint widening) and stopped; then a room's walls (611 teleport) behind at four turns, in front and in first person. AETHYR_CAMERA lines give the view, fov and arm.
